decisions.selected: Improve compatibility of popular repositories using gh-aw.
decisions.rationale: The adoption workflow explicitly requires compile, fix, and recompile checks and identifies compatibility gaps.

decisions.selected: One selected public repository per repeated repository key.
alternatives: One aggregate value for all 20 repositories
decisions.rationale: Per-repository assignment preserves the operational unit and permits duplicate-key clustering.

decisions.selected: Use supplied result; reconstruct the first valid lock-file search result when case and event are null.
decisions.rationale: The workflow defines lock-file search as its selection mechanism; cache and activity are not attainment evidence.

decisions.selected: Explicit post-fix compile success or failure for the assigned repository.
decisions.rationale: Compile status is direct evidence of the intended compatibility outcome.
A stable one-week horizon allows post-fix evidence to settle while keeping daily observations comparable.
A successful compile is the directly observable target; unavailable evidence remains null.
The pre-adoption record describes the workflow proposal but provides no comparable frozen compile-result dataset.

uncertainties.description: Historical code-search ordering may change when the original selected-repository result is unavailable.
uncertainties.mitigation: Preserve supplied cases and use API order only for null historical cases.

uncertainties.description: No comparable pre-adoption compile-result dataset was found.
